visual.general_description: Three volume-rendered CT panels showing millimeter distances from pulmonary vein ostia to the inferior border of the aortic arch for three cases.
visual.detailed_description: Three-panel figure (A, B, C) of volume-rendered three-dimensional CT reconstructions of the heart and aortic arch on black backgrounds. Each panel carries a printed panel letter at the upper left, white double-headed arrows and dark labels with millimeter distances (A: 35.6, 62.7 and 57.4 mm in two views; B: 53.8 mm; C: 61.6 mm), and gray labels naming LSPV, RSPV or LIPV. The aortic arch is cream-colored, the ventricular mass red-orange, with small pale vessels around them. No names, ID numbers or dates are visible.

panels.general_description: Two volume-rendered CT views of the heart with the aortic arch, with three labelled distance lines (35.6 mm, 62.7 mm, 57.4 mm) to LSPV, LIPV and RSPV.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A contains two adjacent volume-rendered three-dimensional CT views on a black background. In the left view the cream-colored aortic arch curves over a red-orange ventricular mass; a white double-headed arrow runs from the underside of the arch down to a dark label reading "35.6 mm", ending near a gray label "LSPV", and a longer white arrow runs from the same arch point to a dark label "62.7 mm" ending near a gray label "LIPV". In the right view, seen from another angle, the arch and heart appear again with one white arrow ending near a dark label "57.4 mm" and a gray label "RSPV". Small pale branch vessels surround the arch. The letter "A" is printed at the upper left.
